title: Settings
subtitle: Profile, preferences and security in one place.

profile.title: User Profile
profile.description: Adjust username, contact information and your profile picture.

display.title: Display & Language
display.description: Control mode, language and timezone centrally.

theme.title: Theme Settings
theme.description: The theme determines the color scheme of the application. Dark Mode is more pleasant for the eyes in poor lighting conditions.
theme.lightDescription: Bright color scheme, ideal in daylight
theme.darkDescription: Dark color scheme, reduces eye strain in low light
theme.autoSave: The setting is automatically saved and remains for future visits

units.title: Units & Formats
units.description: Define the standard units for statistics.

defaults.title: Default Values
defaults.description: New flights will be created with these defaults.

map.title: Map Settings
map.description: Control base map, zoom, and markers.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.description: Manage login protection and data requests.

backup.title: Backup & Sync
backup.description: Control regular backups and cloud sync.
backup.retentionDaysDescription: Backups older than {{days}} days will be automatically deleted

password.title: Change Password
password.error: Error changing password. Please check your current password.

training.title: Training Settings
training.description: Configure the use of trained LLM models for better parsing accuracy
training.useTrainedModelsDescription: Automatically use trained models when available
training.preferredEmailModelDescription: Determines which model is used for email parsing
training.preferredVisionModelDescription: Determines which model is used for boarding pass parsing
training.trainingSeparateModelsDescription: Uses separate models for better specialization (recommended)

help.title: Training Settings
help.description: These settings control whether and how trained LLM models are used.

options.useTrainedModels: Enables automatic use of trained models when available
options.preferredEmailModel: Choose between Auto (trained if available), Trained (trained only) or Base (base model only)
options.preferredVisionModel: Same options for boarding pass parsing
options.trainingSeparateModels: Uses separate models for email and vision (recommended for better specialization)

developer.title: Developer Options
developer.description: Experimental features for LLM training and advanced features
developer.modeDescription: Enables the ability to train local Ollama LLMs
developer.confirmMessage: This feature is experimental and should only be used by experienced users.

items.longTraining: Training may take a long time

help.title: Developer Mode
help.description: Developer Mode enables advanced features for training LLM models.

items.trainingPage: Access to the training page for training Ollama models
items.uploadAnnotation: Upload and annotation of training data (emails, boarding passes)

items.ollama: Ollama must be installed and accessible

help.note: Note: This feature is experimental and may heavily load system resources.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Manage users, invitations, and system settings

autoSaved.title: Auto-saved
autoSaved.description: All settings are saved locally and are immediately active.

parser.title: Parser Configuration
parser.description: Configure how boarding passes and emails are parsed. Auto mode automatically selects the best available parser.

modes.title: Parser Modes:
modes.autoDesc: Automatically selects the best available parser

bestPractices.title: Best Practices:
bestPractices.auto: Use "Auto" for the best balance between accuracy and cost
bestPractices.ollama: Ollama is ideal if you have a GPU and prefer local processing
bestPractices.cloud: Cloud parsers are most accurate but require API keys and incur costs
bestPractices.trained: Trained Ollama models (via Training page) significantly improve accuracy

autoUpdate.title: Automatic Updates
autoUpdate.description: Automatically fetch current flight data from APIs during active flights. Updates will be saved in the pending updates area for review.
autoUpdate.checkIntervalDescription: How often the system checks for flight data updates
autoUpdate.onlyDuringFlightDescription: Only fetch updates during active flight times
autoUpdate.expiryHoursDescription: How long pending updates remain available before expiring

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Manage API keys for external services. Keys shared by the administrator are automatically used.
apiKeys.ownTooltip: Own API key entered - takes precedence over shared keys
apiKeys.notConfiguredTooltip: No API key configured - using shared key or ENV variable if available
apiKeys.sharedNote: This key is shared by the administrator and cannot be edited

airlabs.label: AirLabs API Key
airlabs.description: Free tier: 1000 requests/month. Used for flight data lookup.

aviationstack.label: Aviationstack API Key
aviationstack.description: Paid service. Used for flight data lookup with higher accuracy.

opensky.label: OpenSky Network
opensky.description: Free service. Requires registration. Used for flight data lookup.
